description: Land Commissioner General's Department - Appointed Land Officers for Northern Province, Mr. K. Sivakumar, K. Vasanhan, Mr. S. Shanmugaratnam with effect from 17.09.2010, 20.11.2014 and 05.06.2015
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple appointments of specific individuals (Mr. Kumarasamy Sivakumar, Mr. Kandiah Vasanthan, Mr. Selvaratnam Shanmugaratnam) as Land Officers for the Northern Province under the Land Development Ordinance. While it involves personnel appointments, the content is specifically and exclusively about land administration matters - appointments of Land Officers who handle land development and management. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and other land-related administrative matters, including appointments of land officers who administer these functions.
